sentences.text: Copper sulfate concentrations must be verified twice daily with a calibrated test kit before any additional dosing occurs. A vendor hawks miniature flags at two dollars apiece while the high school band tunes up behind the fire station. "Count the white spots for me," the vet said, "and tell me whether they've spread past the gill covers." "That one's a Stuart," the old gunner told his granddaughter, "and I rode one just like it across Belgium." Fin rot rarely reverses without pristine water; test ammonia daily, because medication breaks down and fouls a small volume fast. Ninety-one and ramrod straight, the parade marshal refused the golf cart and walked every block of the route. One level scoop of kanamycin per five gallons, added right after the fifty-percent water change — never guess the volume. Next year they'll widen the route, the mayor promises, so the half-tracks won't have to squeeze past parked cruisers on Oak. Six days into the ich protocol and the spots are finally dropping off the tetras, though the water smells faintly of salt. You could feel the tracks through the sidewalk before the vehicle ever rounded the corner by the pharmacy. Observation note, 21:40 — the discus took two bloodworms, first food accepted since transfer to the ten-gallon hospital setup. Did you see the turret swing toward the courthouse when the crew waved at the mayor? You raise the heat one degree every twelve hours, watching the thermometer, hoping the cories can handle the climb. Behind the drum line, a lone bagpiper played while names were read aloud at the memorial fountain. After the formalin dip, the koi hung motionless near the surface for a terrifying minute, then righted herself and swam. Diesel smoke drifted over the funnel-cake stand, mixing with powdered sugar until the whole block smelled like 1944 at a county fair. Nobody warns you how loud a bare-bottom hospital setup gets when the airstone runs full blast at 3 a.m. Its Continental radial engine backfired twice near the reviewing stand, startling a pair of police horses. The clown loach in QT bay three stopped eating yesterday, and this morning his caudal fin looks ragged at the edges. Steel treads chewed the fresh asphalt on Elm, leaving herringbone scars the city council would grumble about for weeks. What is the meaning of the word tank?
